title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Practice Table: Prescription Validity, Transfers and Controlled Substances
content:
## Pharmacy practice table

The dispensing pharmacy of the Home Delivery Pharmacy applies the following figures to prescriptions on file, to prescriptions moved in from a retail pharmacy and to controlled substances.

| | Voluntary | Standard | Maintenance 90 | Advantage | Maintenance Choice | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prescriptions may be transferred in from a retail pharmacy | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Business days to obtain a transferred prescription from the retail pharmacy | 7 | 7 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 3 |
| Schedule II controlled substances may be transferred | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Controlled substances dispensed by home delivery | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Adult signature required on delivery of a controlled substance | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Months after the written date a non-controlled prescription remains fillable | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Calendar days after the written date a Schedule II prescription remains fillable | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

### Notes

- Schedule II transfers are never allowed under any program; the member needs a new prescription sent directly by the prescriber.
- Controlled substances are delivered only against an adult signature.

### Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A non-controlled prescription written on 10 March of one year remains fillable for 12 months after that written date. A Schedule II prescription written on the same 10 March remains fillable for 90 calendar days after it.
